To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• There are many ways to improve value for money in LTC.
• There is a need to improve the efficiency of LTC and to reduce the costs of care, while maintaining or improving its quality, but the evidence is limited and inconclusive.

(i) the evidence on the impact of LTC on health and quality of life is limited; (ii) there is little evidence of the impact of LTC policies on health care spending; (iii) the evidence on LTC spending is mixed and the results are often difficult to interpret.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two main questions: 1. What is the value of long-term care?
the following issues: • What are the main drivers of expenditure growth on LTC in the coming decades?
the question: how can OECD countries ensure that LTC systems deliver value for money?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no evidence that one type of LTC system is more cost effective than another.
there is no evidence that one system of LTC provision is more or less efficient than another, but that there are a number of areas where further work is required.
there are no easy answers to the question of how to improve value for money in long-term care.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there are no simple, one-size-fits-all solutions.

there is no single policy solution that will ensure that LTC systems deliver value for money.

, although it is possible to improve the value for money of LTC systems, this is a complex area that needs to be approached with caution.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, while it may be possible to improve efficiency in the sector through better management and coordination of services, the most promising route to improving efficiency in long-term care may be to focus on the prevention of LTC needs, and to reduce the need for formal care through better support for carers and informal care.
there is no one size fits all solution.
there are many possible ways to improve the value for money of LTC systems.
